sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG V07 Early and Late
sources.operational_role: grid-cell rainfall-rate evidence with unit-safe time accumulation
sources.credential_gate: Earthdata Login or PPS registration and operator-provided credentials
sources.geometry_gate: reviewed analytical boundary required before any zonal result

sources.name: India Meteorological Department rainfall API
sources.operational_role: domestic rainfall cross-check; district data is not revenue-circle precision
sources.credential_gate: operator permission and source-host IP whitelisting
sources.geometry_gate: source administrative units retained; no inferred revenue-circle join

sources.name: Copernicus GloFAS v4.5 medium-range forecast
sources.operational_role: 15-day model advisory; never an authorised flood warning
sources.credential_gate: EWDS account, API token, and one-time licence acceptance
sources.geometry_gate: reviewed river topology and upstream-area association; nearest distance forbidden

sources.name: Google Flood Forecasting API
sources.operational_role: typed flood-status and inundation parser after provider approval
sources.credential_gate: waitlist approval, approved email, enabled Cloud project, and API key
sources.geometry_gate: provider gauge and polygon identity retained; no locality inference

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD
sources.operational_role: retrospective scene evidence, not automatic flood-extent truth
sources.credential_gate: Earth Engine project registration or Copernicus Data Space account
sources.geometry_gate: human-reviewed AOI and scene coverage required for event association

sources.name: MERIT Hydro v1.0.1 existing HAND band
sources.operational_role: approximately 90 m terrain prior using the provided hnd band
sources.credential_gate: dataset access and operator acceptance of the selected dual-licence route
sources.geometry_gate: reviewed AOI required before clipping; bifurcation limitation must remain visible
